planets.name: K2-58 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-58 with a 2.54-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-58 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-58. Its orbit and size follow Crossfield et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
